newsitem.title: USA: ArQule files to offer 2 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: ArQule files to offer 2 mln shares.

text.p: ArQule Inc filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer two million shares of common stock.

Of the shares being offered, 1,632,500 shares are being sold by the Medford, Mass.-based company and 367,500 are being offered by selling stockholders. Company proceeds will go toward research and product development, general corporate and working capital purposes.
The underwriters, led by Hambrecht & Quist, have a 30-day option to buy up to 300,000 additional shares to cover over-allotments.
